Hello, Pillar

2026-09-01

This site is the starter that ships with Pillar. Everything on the home page — the hero copy, the three cards, how many posts this list shows — is a setting declared in a <schema> block, edited in the dashboard, and stored in templates/index.json.

Open pillar dev, click the hero, change the heading. The file on disk changes as you type, and git status sees it.
